title: DOM Selector Coupling vs Accessibility-Tree Queries
description: Compare how data-testid hides broken semantics while getByRole enforces ARIA roles and accessible names.

before.label: Coupled DOM Selector (Hides <div onClick>)
before.code:
const btn = page.locator('[data-testid="pay-btn"]');
await btn.click(); // Passes even on a non-focusable <div>
before.previewNote: Passes when <button> is replaced with <div onClick> and no keyboard support.

after.label: Accessibility-Tree Query (AccName 1.2)
after.code:
const btn = page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Pay now' });
await btn.click(); // Fails if role or label is missing
after.previewNote: Enforces semantic role, visible label, and exclusion of inert/hidden subtrees.
